title: Machine Learning Engineer
headline: Machine Learning Engineer
company_hook: Quantcast builds AI-powered advertising technology that optimizes digital ad auctions in real time, delivering measurable outcomes for marketers worldwide.

rephrase.az1: Built a Python-based LLM agent using LangChain and AWS Bedrock to call Claude Haiku 4.5, providing gene alias resolution, scoring-methodology explanation, and dataset provenance for a multi-omics cancer platform.
rephrase.az3: Deployed the agent as a production Docker container on AWS Lambda using Lambda Web Adapter, ECR pipelines, IAM roles, and least-privilege policies.
rephrase.dc1: Proposed and prototyped an MCP-based agentic tool in Python with FastMCP, Ollama gpt-oss:20b, PostgreSQL, and GitHub Actions CI, presenting it in a live stakeholder demo for a Madrid-based startup.
rephrase.fl2: Built an LLM-powered NLP and agentic RAG workflow using Hugging Face Transformers, Ollama, LangChain, and LangGraph.
rephrase.fl1: Built Python-based machine learning pipelines with scikit-learn and deep learning models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker.
rephrase.p_gg1: Built a heterogeneous graph of 1,399 cell lines and 16,385 genes (~2.8M edges) using k-NN similarity and Leiden community detection, achieving modularity 0.822 through clustering.
rephrase.p_gg2: Trained per-gene protein-prediction models for 11,459 genes with OLS and GPU Random Forest ensemble, employing resumable chunked GPU training on a free T4, using Scikit-learn for regression.
rephrase.p_ch1: Developed an XGBoost churn classifier in R with tidymodels, performing two-stage Bayesian hyperparameter search, SMOTE in the recipe, and MCC evaluation, demonstrating classification and machine learning expertise.

paragraphs: Quantcast's real-time ad optimisation demands models that can adapt instantly; I've built an LLM agent that calls specialised tools to resolve gene aliases, explain scoring methods and trace dataset provenance, all within a single, responsive pipeline.
I built scikit-learn pipelines and LSTM, BiRNN and CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker to ensure rapid, reliable inference.
Could we find twenty minutes to talk about where I could contribute first on the Modeling team team at Quantcast?
